refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoEngineCallFunction function calls an in-language function identified by function_name installed in object with argumentsa argc, which signifies the number of in-language arguments passed to the function, and argv which points to the first element of an array of pointers to the in-language arguments passed. argv must have at least as many elements as argc indicates.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: The SilikoEngineCallFunction function returns the result of the called function, or a SilikoValue object with status SilikoValueError and value SilikoErrorFunctionName, if object does not have a matching function installed. The return value must be passed to SilikoValueDestroy to avoid a memory leak.
